meta.title: Bookmark how-to guides: move, back up, export | Snug
meta.description: Step-by-step guides for moving bookmarks between browsers, backing them up, exporting them and removing duplicates, using each browser's built-in tools.

index.title: Bookmark how-to guides
index.lede: Short answers to the bookmark tasks people look up most. Each guide uses the browser's built-in steps, says what carries over and what does not, and shows where Snug adds something.

menuNote: Menu names are shown as in the browser's English interface. Yours may be translated.
ctaTitle: Try Snug on your own bookmarks
ctaBody: Free and open source. No account, no network calls.

placements.importedFolderOrBar: a folder labeled "Imported" when you already have bookmarks, or directly in the bookmarks bar when you do not
placements.favoritesBarFolder: a folder on the Favorites bar, which may be named Imported
placements.sidebarDatedFolder: a sidebar folder whose name begins with Imported and ends with the date
